usedFor: outline holds your team's documents, and Facebook Messenger sends a note from your page with “Send Message from Page”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document Published” in outline, then “Send Message from Page” in Facebook Messenger
bestTemplate.why: Publishing is the finished moment, so readers hear about a document only once it is live.

watchOut: A message from your page reaches someone outside, so “Send Message from Page” waits in Needs you for approval.
